_doc: Signature beats the writer keeps reusing. perChapter = max in one chapter; window/perWindow = max across the last `window` chapters including the target. Regexes are case-insensitive. Add a family whenever a beat starts recurring across chapters.

families.name: subordinate_yardstick
families.description: Sylvanas measures her own lapse by the punishment she would give a ranger ('she'd have flayed a ranger for that'). Seeded by her voice sheet; used about 11 times in chapters 1-5.
families.regex: \b(?:flay(?:ed)?\b[^.!?\n]{0,30}\branger|hide off (?:any|a|the) ranger|skin off (?:him|her)|mucking stalls|walk the outer ring for|sent rangers to their blankets|word to say to any ranger|back to (?:his|her) bench for it|a ranger's hide|go out again and bring me|excuse from a ranger|excuse she would flay)

families.name: prize_student_mockery
families.description: Jaina's 'Brilliant, Jaina. Antonidas's prize student' self-mockery. Lifted verbatim from her voice sheet in chapters 2 and 4.

families.name: duty_done_still_riding
families.description: 'Her duty was done by any measure the chamber would sign. So why was she still riding south?' Voice-sheet argument; one use per arc is plenty.

families.name: elf_ears_stare
families.description: Humans look at the elves' ears. Five times in chapter 5 alone.
families.regex: \b(?:looked|looking|look|stared|staring|glanced|eyeing|taken in|took in)\b[^.!?\n]{0,40}\b(?:at |in )?(?:her|his|their|the|the elves'?|Lyriel's|Sylvanas's|Cyndia's) ears\b(?! went| had gone| going)

families.name: blush_ears
families.description: Ears or face going red or hot as the embarrassment beat.
families.regex: \b(?:ears|face|cheeks|neck) (?:went|going|had gone|were going|was going|had begun to go|came up) (?:red|hot|pink|scarlet)\b|\bwent red (?:to|at|right)\b|\b(?:gone|went|going) red to the ears\b

families.name: no_sleep_sand_eyes
families.description: 'She had not slept since the night before X. Her eyes were full of sand.' Used in chapters 3 and 5 with the same shape.
families.regex: \b(?:had not|hadn't) slept since\b|\beyes (?:felt |were )?(?:full of|rubbed with|gritty with) sand\b

families.name: short_surprised_laugh
families.description: Lyriel jokes, Jaina laughs 'short and surprised', Lyriel checks Cyndia, Cyndia is watching the hedge. Same micro-scene in chapters 2 and 5.

families.name: lyriel_checks_cyndia
families.description: Lyriel glances at Cyndia after a joke and Cyndia gives no sign. Voice-sheet trait; budget it.

families.name: cyndia_weight_even
families.description: Cyndia reports 'with her weight even' at almost every appearance.

families.name: got_down_badly
families.description: Jaina gets on or off the horse 'badly, as always'.

families.name: knees_set
families.description: Knees that have 'set' after riding or kneeling.
families.regex: \bknees (?:had )?set\b|\bknees that had set\b|\bknees\b[^.!?\n]{0,15}\bhad set\b|\bset stiff\b|\bknees stiff as\b

families.name: empty_places_at_back
families.description: The empty places at the back of the line where Neral and the fourth ranger used to ride.
families.regex: \b(?:two |the )?(?:empty )?places (?:at the back|nobody was riding in)\b|\bholes in the back of it\b|\btwo empty places\b

families.name: pleased_with_herself
families.description: A past thought she 'had been pleased with', now deflated.

families.name: spy_hypothesis_ladder
families.description: 'A spy, then. ... One who wants to be caught. Nonsense. ... Or she was right.' Voice-sheet example reused as a template.
families.regex: \bOr (?:she|he|it) was right\b|\bOne who wants to be caught\b|\bNo, nonsense\b
